const data = $input.item.json; const isApproved = data.status === 'Approved'; const subject = isApproved ? `Invoice Approved: ${data.projectName} - ${data.invoicePeriod}` : `Invoice Flagged: ${data.projectName} - ${data.invoicePeriod}`; const body = isApproved ? `

Invoice Approved

Hi ${data.contractorName},

Your invoice for ${data.projectName} (${data.invoicePeriod}) has been approved and logged for payment.

Hours${data.hoursWorked}h
Rate$${data.agreedRate}/hr
Total$${data.totalSubmitted}

Payment will be processed on the next billing cycle.

` : `

Invoice Flagged for Review

Hi ${data.contractorName},

Your invoice for ${data.projectName} (${data.invoicePeriod}) has been flagged and requires correction before it can be approved.

Issue: ${data.flagReason}

Please resubmit with the corrected details. Reply to this email if you have questions.

`; return { emailTo: data.contractorEmail, emailSubject: subject, emailBody: body, status: data.status, contractorName: data.contractorName, projectName: data.projectName, flagReason: data.flagReason };
